description.zh: 要删除的报警规则ID列表。格式为JSONArray，例如：`[123, 234]`。可调用SearchAlertRules接口获取报警规则ID（对应返回参数中的`Id`），详情请参见[SearchAlertRules](~~175825~~)。
description.en: The IDs of the alert rules that you want to delete. The value is a JSON array, for example, `[123, 234]`. You can call the SearchAlertRules operation and view the `Id` parameter in the response to obtain the alert rule ID. For more information, see [SearchAlertRules](~~175825~~).
